column2: Exactly seven separate round flat discs, like thick smooth coins with softly rounded edges, float scattered across the whole frame at different heights and different tilts, well apart from each other, none touching, all of them in the upper two thirds of the frame; the lower third of the frame is empty. Seen straight on from slightly above.

the same seven discs have drifted toward one point in the upper middle of the frame and turned closer to level; they are now a loose cluster and three of them partly overlap. Nothing added, nothing removed, still exactly seven discs.

the same seven discs are now lined up one above another in a loose, slightly leaning column in the upper middle of the frame, each disc nearly level, with uneven gaps of air between them. Nothing added, nothing removed, still exactly seven discs.

the same seven discs have settled into one neat disc stack in the upper middle of the frame, every disc level and directly above the one below, with a small even gap of air between each. Nothing added, nothing removed, still exactly seven discs. The lower third of the frame stays empty.
